players.product: NdPr oxide and sintered NdFeB permanent magnets

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer General Motors: Ryan Corbett (MP Materials) said the target is to start commercial magnet deliveries at the end of this year; the magnets are qualified and on-spec, and MP is working through the final stages of PPAP (production part approval process) — daily output and slotting each part number into each GM facility; 'More to come shortly.'

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ryan Corbett (MP Materials) on NdPr refining: separation capacity came online at the very tail end of 2023 and Mountain Pass is now at roughly 1,000 tons a quarter of NdPr production; MP is targeting full run-rate capacity at the end of this year (he said Lynas took almost seven years to reach full run rate). Remaining items are mechanical reliability as throughput rises and materials movement, not fundamental chemistry issues.
quarterly_data.figure: roughly 1,000 tons a quarter of NdPr production; full run rate targeted at the end of this year

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 10X magnet facility and funding (Ryan Corbett, MP Materials): MP is targeting getting into production at 10X at the end of 2028; the Department of Defense is the 100% offtaker with a guaranteed minimum earnings level, with the goal of commercially syndicating the output to commercial and defense-industrial-base customers, and the minimum guaranteed EBITDA 'does not represent necessarily where we think the ultimate economics of that plant will be'. He said MP can keep funding its laid-out investments off the balance sheet; the Independence expansion for Apple and the Mountain Pass recycling build are funded from an Apple prepayment, and the Magnetics segment and Independence turn cash generative as commercial magnet deliveries begin.
quarterly_data.figure: 10X production targeted at the end of 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ryan Corbett (MP Materials) on China export restrictions: November would mark a year of a pause on certain export restrictions, but customers ask 'what pause?' — public trade data on gadolinium, yttrium and heavy-rare-earth-containing (dysprosium, terbium) magnets going into Japan are basically zero, and pretty close to zero into the U.S.; export licenses for magnets 'have flowed some, but not very much'. He said customers see the supply chain as unable to rely on China whatever the Trump-Xi summit brings; for humanoid robotics magnets there is a hard bifurcation (Western customers will not be able to get any of their magnet needs from China), while in automotive GM chose a domestic source for domestic vehicle production.

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ryan Corbett (MP Materials) on the NdPr bottleneck: ex-China scaled NdPr oxide production is effectively MP and Lynas, and current ex-China magnet capacity and NdPr supply are relatively balanced; adding the announced Western magnet capacity would require immediately doubling NdPr production, before the demand growth expected from robots, data centers, automotive, energy and consumer electronics. He does not see another high-quality hard-rock NdPr mine on the horizon that makes sense at today's NdPr prices, so either commodity prices must respond massively or magnet capacity will be built without supply to fill it.

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Saudi Arabia: Ryan Corbett (MP Materials) said the deal announced in November of last year, under which MP and the Department of Defense would partner with Ma’aden to bring a rare earth refining facility to Saudi Arabia, still stands on its case of a centrally located refinery able to take a wide variety of global feedstocks with easy, low-cost access to raw materials, chemicals and power, despite the region's recent challenges; MP will approach it capital light, leveraging its intellectual property. No size was given.

quarterly_data.quarter: MP Materials Jefferies Global Industrials Conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Strategy (Ryan Corbett, MP Materials): MP considers going further downstream — 'It would not be crazy' to see a magnet customer ask 'why not the actuator or the motor?' — and would be extremely disciplined about it. On M&A he likes the current asset base as what MP needs to execute, but would look at buying assets 'for cents on the dollar' if others' execution falters. For upstream, further investment in Mountain Pass has always won against other opportunities; MP expects to add incremental supply by taking third-party feedstocks into Mountain Pass and through smaller opportunities such as ionic clays, but sees no significant new deposit that makes sense by comparison.
